title: Measuring Representational Harms in Image Captioning
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure aspects of faith or religion. The focus was on measuring five types of representational harms (denying self-identification, reifying social groups, stereotyping, erasing, demeaning) in image captions, with a specific focus on social groups defined by perceived gender and skin tone.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion, faith, or religious groups.
